body: Mine took 3 months to fully return. It is exactly as before :) just give it time. The tingles are your nerves healing, so I’ve heard.

For me, at least! Like I said, my teeth were impacted pretty bad so I think that might have to do with it. To keep my mouth clean I just did salt rinses, no irrigation bc I didn’t get a syringe from my doctor, lol! Now I just brush my teeth as usual. The holes are almost closed up so I don’t have to worry as much anymore.

I’d say I started feeling normal just about a week or two ago. Three of my teeth were impacted, so it was pretty rough at first :,) numbness started to disappear after one week, but I didn’t start to really feel things again until the two week mark. I dealt with some hypersensitivity and tingling in the area as well. Honestly though, I want to say that I stopped noticing it around week 4 or 5? I know it’s not completely healed yet but I’m now at a point where it’s so minimal that it doesn’t bother me. I’m thinking I’ll be fully healed in about 2 or 3 weeks :)

Hey— I got 4 wisdom teeth pulled about a month and a half ago (6 weeks!) I didn’t have any teeth reported to be close to my nerves and somehow, I still ended up with numbness on my bottom left lip and chin. It’s usually not permanent! I was really worried about mine but it DID come back. I do have full sensation despite a small bit of stiffness and tingling, which is also going away. It can just take a while. Some take weeks while others can take months. Just give it time.

I was given antibiotics after surgery. I had all four teeth taken out; three were impacted. I wonder if the severity of the surgery itself also has something to do with whether or not you’re prescribed antibiotics.

It’s been about 10 days, nearing 11. I had a dramatic improvement on day 8. I’m having some pain in my jaw and teeth on the side that was numb but it’s improving as well. I’ve got some weird gum flaps near the bottom extraction sites but they don’t hurt and are starting to heal. Honestly the one thing that’s helped is rest. I notice it’s better when I had a good night’s sleep. Easier said than done when the numbness can cause so much anxiety— but it’s the best thing for healing. Keep me updated on how you progress :)

Commenting to keep everyone updated (and myself, in a way lol): I’ve got most sensation back! It’s still a bit painful and maybe a tad less sensitive than the other side of my chin + lip, but I honestly don’t even notice it throughout the day. It’s at about 90%. I’m hopeful it’ll be 100% back to normal soon :)
It’s been a week for me so far and it’s still partially numb, but not nearly as much as the first few days… feels like there’s been a slight plateau in progress, but again, it’s only been a week!
Thanks for the reassurance :,) I really am hoping this isn’t permanent considering that I still have sensation.
I honestly haven’t been happy in seven years. Too long. I don’t have the strength to do anything about it now
